introHtml: Purple lanyards offer a distinct way to coordinate ID badges or event credentials, especially for teams looking to stand out with a bold, regal color. Choose from durable knit-in or woven styles like the 3/4" Woven Lanyard for full-color logo reproduction, or opt for a comfortable cotton option for everyday wear. Whether you need a custom purple lanyard for a trade show or employee identification, our range of materials and attachment options ensures a professional look that aligns with your brand colors.
